name: Cracked Bell Wraith
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Resonant Body
Traits.text: A creature that hits the bell wraith with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn.

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The bell wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the bell wraith has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The bell wraith makes two Grave Toll attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Cracked Toll.

Actions.name: Grave Toll
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. 30 (7d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Cracked Toll
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 19, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. If the target was already Frightened by this ability, it also takes 52 (15d6) Necrotic damage.
Actions.gmQuote: a bell wraith that tolls once for fear

lore: A bell-wraith is what remains of one who died mid-toll when the bell cracked and the ring never finished; it drifts the world seeking the final stroke that will let it rest.

generation.userConcept: a bell-wraith that tolls once for fear, twice for sleep, and three times for the grave
generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
monsterDescription: a bell-wraith that tolls once for fear, twice for sleep, and three times for the grave
